summary: TMD Energy Ltd, a Malaysian-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of an 8-K current report) disclosing voting results from its 2026 Annual General Meeting held October 7, 2026 in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia. A quorum of 19,625,182 of 23,565,000 ordinary shares voted. Proposal One passed 19,417,360 to 205,378, redesignating shares into 400,000,000 Class A (one vote) and 100,000,000 Class B (20 votes), with Straits Energy Resources Berhad's 10,000,000 shares converted to high-vote Class B. Proposal Two adopted amended articles. No special situation; routine meeting results and a recapitalization.
